title: CLI Reference
content: title: cli reference    cli reference  this page provides the complete reference for the mopress command-line executable. for day-to-day getting started guides, please refer to quick start (book mode) or site mode first. this page is intended for reference purposes.  basic usage  bash mopress    when  is omitted or unrecognised, mopress gracefully falls back to displaying help information, equivalent to running mopress help, without exiting with an error.  command overview    command   description               init   initialize a new book mode project, with optional directory: mopress init dir     new   scaffold a new site mode project: mopress new  --template <blog\|minimal>     build   build the site (analyze enabled by default, supports --no-analyze, --no-emit, --analyze-json)     explain   print rule match diagnostics and estimated output list (dry-run)     serve   start a local development server for live preview     version   display version and build information     help   display usage and help information    strict option validation: all subcommands strictly validate incoming command-line options. if any unrecognised option is passed (e.g. mopress build --unknown), the command will immediately exit with an error, preventing accidental typos from executing unexpected actions silently.  mopress init  bash mopress init dir   specifically designed for book mode users to initialize documentation projects. - if dir is omitted, initialization happens in the current working directory. - if dir is specified, the book mode scaffold is created in the specified subfolder.  if a sena.toml configuration file already exists in the target directory, init prints an informational notice and exits safely without overwriting your setup. otherwise, it will sequentially create the config file, summary.md, index.md, and scaffold default assets in templates/, styles/, scripts/, and plugins/.  init is idempotent: re-running it in an initialized directory exits early once sena.toml is detected. note that this check only verifies whether sena.toml exists; if individual templates or styles have been removed while keeping sena.toml, init will not backfill them.  mopress new  bash mopress new  --template <blog|minimal>   designed for site mode users to create static site projects. - : required target directory. - --template  (or -t): optional template type:   - blog (default): full-featured blog with example posts (posts/hello-world.md), seo metadata, reading time calculations, excerpt extraction, and a unified pipeline in site.mbtx.   - minimal: minimal static site structure (index.md, about.md, contact.md) with a lightweight build script.  mopress build  bash mopress build --no-emit --no-analyze --analyze-json   reads the configuration in the current working directory, executes the full book mode build pipeline: parses navigation structure, generates 404 page, renders all markdown pages with templates, and outputs results into the build target folder.  build performance profiling is enabled by default. upon build completion, mopress prints a clear terminal performance report, including: - breakdown of build steps (preprocessing, ast transforms, markdown rendering, templates, asset injections) with total time, page average, max time, and call counts. - page performance table with html output size (b/kb/mb), total render time, template render count (including recursive partials), and slowest step. - overall stats: total page count, output byte size, average page size, and total build time.  option details: - --no-analyze: disables performance profiling output, displaying only standard progress logs. - --analyze: explicitly enables performance profiling (enabled by default; rarely needed manually). - --no-emit: runs the entire build and transformation pipeline in memory without writing any files to disk. ideal for ci verification and dry-run prechecks. - --analyze-json: silences normal build logs and prints a machine-readable json performance report to standard output (stdout), suitable for ci/cd benchmarks and dashboards.  mopress explain  bash mopress explain   analyzes current file match rules and config, printing which files match which rules and estimating the output manifest without writing files to disk.  mopress serve  bash mopress serve   reads current configuration, initializes options, and launches a local development preview server.  mopress version  bash mopress version   prints the current version string and build details.  mopress help  bash mopress help   prints help details and short summaries of all available commands.  site mode command-line  the commands above target the pre-compiled mopress binary for book mode. under site mode, your build script is a standalone moonbit program executed directly:  bash moon run --target native site.mbtx     supports build (along with --no-emit, --analyze, --analyze-json), serve, and explain, behaving identically to their book mode equivalents. --target native directs moonbit to compile against the native target.

title: 贡献
content: title: 贡献指南    贡献指南  感谢你对 mopress 的关注与支持！无论是提交 bug 报告、提出功能建议、完善文档、贡献核心代码，还是向 插件枢纽 提交你开发的插件，我们都非常欢迎。     1. 准备开发环境  在开始贡献代码前，请确保你的本地环境中安装了以下工具：  - moonbit：最新的 moonbit 编译器与工具链。 - bun（或 node.js）：用于运行构建预处理脚本及外部插件协议测试。 - just：通用的命令运行工具（可选，但推荐用于便捷执行常用构建脚本）。 - git：版本管理工具。  !caution 由于 moonbit native 后端的平台特性，windows 用户建议确保系统安装并配置了 msvc（visual studio c++ 构建工具）环境，而非 mingw。     2. 本地开发与构建流程  克隆项目并安装依赖  bash git clone https://github.com/biyuehu/mopress.git cd mopress  更新 moonbit 依赖 moon update  安装 git 提交钩子（推荐） just init   生成嵌入资源（prebuild）  mopress 在编译时会将内置的模板、静态资源与演示项目转录为 moonbit 源码（src/includes.mbt）。在修改了相关资源或执行编译/测试前，请先执行：  bash just prebuild 等价于：bun scripts/gen-includes.ts   运行测试  bash just test 等价于：just prebuild && moon test   mopress 包含单元测试与快照测试。若改动影响到了预期的快照输出，可运行快照更新命令：  bash moon test --update   代码格式化与接口检查  在准备提交代码前，请确保代码已通过 moonbit 官方格式化并更新了生成的接口声明文件（.mbti）：  bash moon fmt moon info   !tip 如果项目配置了 lefthook，在执行 git commit 时会自动触发 pre-commit 钩子，按顺序执行 prebuild、代码格式化、接口更新与全量测试。     3. 提交规范（pull request）  1. 创建分支：从 main 分支切出具名功能分支，如 git checkout -b feat/my-new-feature 或 fix/resolve-issue-123。 2. 提交信息规范：遵循 conventional commits 格式，常见类型包括：    - feat: 新增功能    - fix: 修复缺陷    - docs: 文档改动    - test: 新增或修复测试    - chore: 构建脚本、依赖或工具链调整 3. 编写测试：为新功能或修复的 bug 添加对应的测试用例（黑盒测试 test.mbt 或白盒测试 wbtest.mbt）。 4. 提交 pr：发起 pull request 并详细说明改动动机、设计思路与影响范围。     4. 插件枢纽（plugin hub）收录申请  如果你开发了适用于 mopress 的插件（包括预处理器、转换器、web components 或 moonbit 模块），欢迎申请收录进 插件枢纽！  收录步骤  1. 将你的插件开源并发布到公开仓库（如 github、gitee、codeberg）或 npm / mooncakes。 2. 编辑本项目仓库中的 `docs/plugins.json`，在数组末尾追加你的插件元数据：    json    {      "name": "插件名称",      "url": "https://github.com/username/your-plugin-repo",      "type": "transformers",      "description": "简要描述插件的功能与适用场景。"    }     3. 提交 pr，标题格式例如：docs: add  to plugin hub。  插件类型（type 字段）  type 字段必须为以下四种之一：    类型   说明               preprocessers   文本预处理器（基于外部程序，通过 stdin/stdout 转换原始 markdown 文本）     transformers   ast 转换器（基于外部程序，通过 stdin/stdout 变换 markdown ast 节点）     webcomponents   前端运行时 web component 组件（配合 html 块或内嵌标签使用）     moonbit   moonbit 原生 step 模块（适用于 site 模式的进程内管道函数）    插件质量要求  - 开源透明：插件仓库需包含清晰的开源许可证（如 mit、apache-2.0、gpl 等）。 - 使用说明：readme 中需提供接入 mopress（sena.toml 或 site.mbtx）的配置示例。 - 稳定性与安全：插件在非正常输入下应能安全退出，外部脚本错误输出需遵循 mopress 插件协议。     5. 报告问题与建议  遇到 bug 或有新的功能想法？欢迎通过以下途径反馈：  - bug 报告：在 github issues 中详细提供复现步骤、最小复现示例（markdown 与 sena.toml）、操作系统环境以及错误日志。 - 功能讨论：可以在 issue 或 discussions 中发起讨论，分享你的使用场景与设计设想。

title: Introduction
content: title: introduction    mopress  mopress is a modern documentation and general static site generator built for the moonbit ecosystem, inspired by mdbook and hakyll. it utilizes an embedded dsl (domain specific language) for configuration and functional pipelines to express build workflows, accompanied by a rich, language-agnostic plugin ecosystem and extensive customization capabilities.  why mopress?  if you just want to quickly write documentation or publish a blog, you shouldn't have to reinvent the wheel with a custom build system. but if your needs go beyond writing standard markdown and applying a default template, you shouldn't be boxed in by tool constraints either. mopress is designed to solve both problems through two harmonious modes:  - **book mode**: ready out of the box, offering an experience familiar to users of mdbook. all you need is a sena.toml configuration file and a collection of markdown documents—no code required. at the same time, it provides features beyond mdbook, including multiple plugin models, code injection, custom templates, frontmatter metadata, and ast transformers. - **site mode**: express custom rules and processing pipelines as a dsl in site.mbtx. using a wide array of granular, composable steps, you gain full control over how content is processed and rendered, leveraging the expressiveness of functional programming without getting bogged down in low-level plumbing.  both modes share the same foundational engine (markdown parsing, template engine, external plugin protocol, etc.). in essence, site mode is a general-purpose static site generator, while book mode is an out-of-the-box documentation generator implemented as a best-practice opinionated workflow on top of site mode.  where to go next  - to see results immediately, start with quick start. - if you already know which workflow suits your project, jump directly to book mode or site mode. - for deeper customization, explores templates, globbing, and plugins in advanced.  support mopress      keep this project alive

title: Plugins Hub
content: title: plugins hub    plugins hub  mopress features an open and extensible plugin ecosystem. whether you are using book mode or site mode, plugins allow you to customize syntax extensions, asset pipelines, custom shortcodes, and integrations.  plugin types  1. external process plugins (cli / protocol): language-agnostic executables or scripts that communicate with mopress over stdin/stdout using standard json-rpc style protocols. write plugins in python, node.js, rust, go, or shell scripts. 2. web components: custom html elements for interactive documentation widgets, tabs, embedded previews, and reactive elements. 3. moonbit native modules: high-performance in-process modules that link directly with mopress steps and ast transformers without process boundary overhead.  discovering plugins  explore community plugins and skills in the official moonbit community repository:   related documentation  - external plugin protocol - web components guide - moonbit native modules

title: Contributing
content: title: contributing guide    contributing guide  thank you for your interest in mopress! whether you are reporting bugs, proposing features, improving documentation, contributing core features, or publishing plugins to the plugins hub, contributions are warmly welcomed.     1. prerequisites  before starting development, ensure you have the following installed locally:  - moonbit: the latest moonbit compiler and toolchain. - bun (or node.js): for running asset generators and external plugin protocol test suites. - just: command runner (recommended for running common tasks). - git: version control.  !caution for moonbit's native target on windows, ensure the msvc (visual studio c++ build tools) environment is installed and active.     2. local development & workflow  clone and install dependencies  bash git clone https://github.com/biyuehu/mopress.git cd mopress  update moonbit dependencies moon update  install git hooks (recommended) just init   prebuild assets  mopress embeds default templates, static stylesheets, and demo projects directly into moonbit source code (src/includes.mbt). run prebuild after changing these assets:  bash just prebuild equivalent to: bun scripts/gen-includes.ts   running tests  bash just test equivalent to: just prebuild && moon test   mopress has comprehensive unit and snapshot tests. if intentional changes affect snapshot outputs, update them with:  bash moon test --update   formatting and interface verification  before submitting code, ensure formatting and package interface declarations (.mbti) are updated:  bash moon fmt moon info      3. pull request guidelines  1. create a feature branch from main: git checkout -b feat/my-feature 2. follow conventional commits for your commit messages (e.g. feat: ..., fix: ..., docs: ...). 3. ensure all tests pass (moon test) and moon fmt produces no uncommitted changes.
